Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the verified data from the previous steps. In Step 8, the WebSurfer successfully extracted "June 10, 1819" from both Britannica and the Institut Gustave Courbet pages. However, in Step 10, the Planner stated the date was "October 6, 1819" (claiming it was standardized from "10/06/1819"). This is a hallucination; the sources explicitly wrote "June 10, 1819" in text format, not "10/06/1819". The Planner swapped the month and day, likely misinterpreting the European date format convention (DD/MM/YYYY) despite the source text clearly stating the month name "June". This contradicts the evidence gathered in Step 8.
